_doc: DATA_RUNBOOK §170 (2026-09-26, user-approved): the pre-2020 Nifty-500 demergers the feed-driven builder never adjusted (build_demerger_adj.py sweeps 2016+ and only 'demerger/spin-off' wording; these were filed as 'Scheme of Arrangement') + KESORAMIND 2025 (95% gap, the builder's by-hand floor). Every event is a spin-off with shares of the resulting company issued to holders (filing quote per event). Factor rule: ex-day OPEN / previous close where the open was a real auction - every ex-date from 2015-10-01, when NSE's special pre-open call auction became mandatory on corporate-restructuring ex-dates (NSE/CMTR/57270), and older days where (the day's price band was reset around it, or the day traded within 5% of it) - the post-2020 rule; ex-day CLOSE / previous close where it was not (open pinned at the old price band vs the previous close, or a lone print the day traded >5% away from). For 'close' events the ex-day's own open/high/low are set to the close by update_sf_data.flatten_demerger_exdays (flatten_exday=true): those prints were at the old company's price level (ADANIENT 2015-06-03 opened 573.30 at the -10% band, closed 109.75). previous close = our previous bar's raw NSE close (PGIL: NSE re-based PREVCLOSE to 170, real close 228.30). Same 2% materiality rule as the builder (factor >= 0.98 -> not adjusted). The ledger rows themselves live in demerger_adj.json; this file is their provenance + the flatten list. Also (user-approved the same day): the 7 pre-2016 rows ledgered BEFORE this rule that priced by the open where the rule says close are re-priced (field repriced_from = the old factor); 3 of them closed above the previous close, so their factor is 1.0 - kept as a row so self_heal UNDOES the old adjustment (deleting the row would leave it baked in). §170d (user, 2026-09-26): the 2% materiality floor is DROPPED (build_demerger_adj.MIN_GAP 1.0) - every gap is adjusted, only an open/close at or above the previous close means no adjustment; the 12 Nifty-500 spin-offs the old floor skipped are added here with the same pricing rule. CORRECTION (2026-09-26, user-approved): UNIONBANK 2009-05-13 was wrongly re-priced here as an 'older demerger row' - it is a §102e large-dividend separation (Rs 5, 3.03%, (prev-div)/prev = 0.9697, user-approved 2026-08-23, commit 59b967a18), not a demerger; its row is restored to 0.9697 and it is no longer listed here. | §179h (user 2026-10-07: "take ex day average price before 2015 for all companies"): every demerger ex-date BEFORE 2015-10-01 is now priced by the ex-day AVERAGE traded price (NSE bhavcopy TOTTRDVAL / TOTTRDQTY, era symbol) / previous close, capped at 1.0; the §170 open/close rule stays only in rule_170 / factor_170 for the record. From 2015-10-01 the auction-open rule is unchanged; ex-day flattening (flatten_exday) is unchanged. | §179i (user 2026-10-07, option 2): every demerger day keeps its TRADED open/high/low (Quantmac: "demerger prints remain raw"); the 33 days §170 set to the close carry restore_exday (flatten_exday_170 keeps the old flag) and update_sf_data.flatten_demerger_exdays rebuilds their open/high/low from the raw prints stored here x the bar's own adjustment. | §179m (user 2026-10-08: "always consider auction price first ... if there are no auction prices then the average of the day"): a demerger ex-date before 2015-10-01 with an NSE pre-open call auction (per the day's NSE circular) is priced by the auction open / previous close (auction_circular); other pre-2015 days keep the average price. FRL 17-Apr-2013, FRL 21-Jun-2013, ADANIENT 03-Jun-2015 (open pinned at the -10% limit) stay on the average price pending the owner. | §179n (user 2026-10-08): REIAGROLTD 25-Nov-2008 restructuring (demerger + 5:3 consolidation, CSE notice 19-Sep-2008) added: factor = ex-day average price / previous close.
